final: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) AS k FROM races) SELECT c.circuitId, c.n AS race_count, c.n*1.0/t.total AS share, c.n*1.0/t.total - 1.0/t.k AS margin_above_avg FROM c, t ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
